sources.title: TC Electronic Zeus Drive Review - Premier Guitar
sources.excerpt: TC Electronic Zeus Drive Review Admission to the Klon ballpark at a bargain price. Aug 29, 2021 TC Electronic Zeus Drive 4.2 Tones Build Design Ease of use Value Street: $69 Pros: A ticket to the Klon show for an unbeatable price. Easy to plug in, dial up, and play. Cons: The fat boost is more necessity than option. Narrower dirt and volume range than pricier competitors.
